rationale: The single 1-minute candle available shows an extremely wide-range bar (H=87.08, L=84.80) that encompasses nearly the entire day's range, indicating violent price discovery with no clear directional resolution. The last price at $86.43 sits below the 9-EMA ($87.22) and below the open ($87.08), suggesting early selling pressure, but the spread is wide (26.6 bps), volume is concentrated in one chaotic candle, and there is insufficient bar-by-bar structure to identify a reliable entry with a well-defined invalidation level. Waiting for price action to stabilize and form a cleaner setup is the prudent course.
